title: APIv2 PCR Prep 4/4: PCR
author: Opentrons
materials: for 96 samples using the P20 Multi-channel pipette. --- * [P20 Multi-channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [10/20uL Opentrons tipracks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601](bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Labcon 0.2mL PCR strips #3940-550](http://www.labcon.com/microstrips.html) * Labcon Plate * PCR Cooler --- Slot
96-well Labcon plate on PCR cooler Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT‑2 deck as specified:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: 96‑well Labcon plate on PCR cooler
Slot 2: Pre‑chilled PCR cooler with a Labcon 0.2 mL PCR strip placed in column 1 and filled with master mix
Slot 3: Aluminum Block Adapter with a Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL, #hsp9601) filled with DNA samples from EXO step 3/4
Slot 4: 96‑well PCR plate filled with primers
Slots 5‑11: 10/20 µL Opentrons tipracks (10 µL tips) for the P20 multi‑channel pipette

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the OT‑2 protocol editor.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the deck map (as described in the deck layout step).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tipracks, and the P20 multi‑channel pipette using the OT App.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the PCR preparation.
